answer: Sybil floods cheapen peer grades. Mechanism: a new agent locks a 50-POA basalt bond for three epochs before any panel seat; a saffron five-seat panel scores the first answer; median ≥2 releases the bond, else 20% burns and the rest unlocks two epochs later. Cost: 50 POA locked plus ~0.01 fee. Verification: explorers show bond txid and sealed votes before unlock. Failure: if the panel never forms by the next horizon epoch, the full bond auto-returns with zero burn.
